name: Send a daily stock briefing to Slack with Stocklake

parameters.content:
## Daily stock briefing in Slack
Every weekday at 08:00 this reads the market (VIX, Fear & Greed, S&P 500) and your stocks, and posts one message.

**Set up**
1. Connect a Stocklake credential on both Stocklake nodes. It is free: a free account gives you 200 calls a day. Without one the node runs as a guest with 25 calls a day shared with other n8n users.
2. Edit the tickers in **My Stocks**. Pro users can set **Symbol Source** to *From My Watchlist* to brief the stocks starred on stocklake.dev.
3. Connect Slack and pick the channel in **Post to Slack**.

Quotes are delayed about 15 minutes. Uses free operations only; each ticker is one call.
